text: Deputy Daniel Carter finds a wounded man crawling along a road and brings him to [a half-abandoned hospital|images|buildings and public places] where his estranged wife Allison works as a nurse. Within hours a nurse with her face flayed murders a patient, [robed cultists surround the building|threat|the group turns on you], and her corpse becomes [a tentacled creature|images|monsters and hybrid creatures]. In the basement, Dr. Powell, grieving his daughter Sarah, has found a rite that [lets him defy death|wants|getting back the lost].
